title: Cygnus olor - Mute Swan XC434964
author: Joost van Bruggen
changes: Mute swans (Cygnus olor) flying low overhead at night: the loud, throbbing, humming wing beats mute swans are known for (they are otherwise quiet birds), a recording from Arnhem shared through Xeno-canto (XC434964). Trimmed to 11.70–14.60 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
